Publication Title	The ERBB network facilitates KRAS-driven lung tumorigenesis.
Publication Status
Publication Status Term Source REF
Publication Status Term Accession Number

Experiment Description	KRAS mutation is widely presumed to confer independence from upstream RTK signalling, however emerging evidence from mouse models of lung cancer suggests that ERBB RTKs may amplify signalling through RAS isoforms and participate in mutant RAS-driven lung cancer.  This is one of 3 datasets where we examined the transcriptional impact of treatment of KRAS mutant human lung cancer cell lines with the multi-ERBB inhibitor Neratinib

Protocol Name	P-MTAB-71904	P-MTAB-71905	P-MTAB-71906	P-MTAB-71908	P-MTAB-71907	P-MTAB-71909	P-MTAB-71910
Protocol Type	growth protocol	treatment protocol	sample collection protocol	nucleic acid library construction protocol	nucleic acid extraction protocol	nucleic acid sequencing protocol	high throughput sequence alignment protocol
Protocol Term Source REF	EFO	EFO	EFO	EFO	EFO	EFO	EFO
Protocol Term Accession Number	EFO_0003789	EFO_0003969	EFO_0005518	EFO_0004184	EFO_0002944	EFO_0004170	EFO_0004917
Protocol Description	Cells were maintained in RPMI1640 media supplemented with 10% FBS & penn/strep.  Cells were passaged every 2-3 days and discarded after no more than 20 passages	Cells in log phase growth were treated with 500nM Neratinib or DMSO vehicle control for 20 hrs, commencing less than 24 hrs after reseeding in fresh media	Clles were washed 2x in PBS and lysd directly on growth plates using Qiagen RNEassy lysis buffer	cDNA was synthesized with the TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit (Illumina)	Total RNA was isolated using the RNEasy Mini Kit (Qiagen) according to manufacturer’s instructions and DNA was depleted with the RNase-Free DNase Set	libraries were standardized to 10nM, denatured, diluted to 10pM and analyzed by paired-end sequencing using an Illumina NextSeq500 platform	RNA-Sequencing reads were aligned to the GRCh37 version of the human genome and differential expression determined using DESeq2
Protocol Parameters
Protocol Hardware						NextSeq 500
Protocol Software							Tophat2 version 2.0.10 & Bowtie version 2.1.0
